title: Batch add
description: Plan up to 50 draft ideas in a spreadsheet-style grid. Each row can use its own channels and format.

form.placeholder:
Spring collection | static_post | 2026-09-05 09:00 | Single image announcing the pre-order
Studio behind the scenes | short_form_video | 2026-09-06 18:00 | 20-second vertical Reel showing the roasting process
How to brew the autumn blend | long_form_video | 2026-09-07 10:00 | Eight-minute YouTube tutorial with chapters
form.importDescription: Paste spreadsheet cells to create editable rows, or add ideas one at a time below.
form.formatGuideDescription: Creative details such as scenes, chapters, duration, and visual direction are completed after the draft is created.
form.batchTooLarge: A batch can contain at most {max} rows.
form.title: Title
form.fixErrors: Fix all blocking errors before saving.
form.pasteDescription: Copy rows from a spreadsheet with columns for Title, Format, Date & time, Short brief, and Channels.
form.pasteHint: Dates without an offset use the workspace timezone ({timezone}). Raw pipe rows remain supported; channels can be selected in the grid.

validation.date_invalid: Use a valid date and time in the workspace timezone.
validation.brief_empty: A brief helps the team understand the idea.
validation.duplicate_date: Another row uses this date and time.
validation.channel_unknown: One or more channels could not be matched.

static_post.description: One image, text, or static feed post. No video duration or scene list is required.
static_post.detail: Later: add the hook, message, CTA, hashtags, and references.

carousel.description: A sequence of images or cards for a swipeable post.
carousel.detail: Later: define each card, message, and visual direction.

story.detail: Later: add frames, stickers, captions, and timing.

short_form_video.description: A Reel, TikTok, or Short; normally vertical and fast to watch.
short_form_video.detail: Later: add scenes, on-screen text, voice-over, audio, captions, and cover direction.

long_form_video.description: A YouTube, LinkedIn, or other long-form video.
long_form_video.detail: Later: add the description, chapters, captions, and references.

live_content.description: A live stream or scheduled broadcast.
live_content.detail: Later: add the run of show, host, and supporting details.

article.description: A written article, blog post, or newsletter-style entry.
article.detail: Later: add the outline, body, references, and CTA.

other.description: A custom content item that does not fit another format.
other.detail: Later: describe the deliverable in More details.
